suppress.notes: False positive — wrong product. CVE-2022-31691 (CVSS 9.8) is an RCE in the YAML editing support of *Spring Tools 4 for Eclipse* (<= 4.16.0) and the related VSCode extensions (Spring Boot Tools, Concourse CI Pipeline Editor, Bosh Editor, Cloudfoundry Manifest YML Support). It has nothing to do with the `spring-boot-devtools` library; Dependency-Check matches it on the shared `vmware:spring_boot` CPE. Independently, devtools is declared `developmentOnly`, so it is never packaged into a deployable artifact. Re-evaluate if a CVE is ever published against the devtools library itself.

False positive — version out of range. CVE-2020-29582 is the Kotlin `createTempDir`/`createTempFile` information disclosure, which affects kotlin-stdlib <= 1.4.20 and was fixed in 1.4.21. Every JetBrains Kotlin artifact on any classpath here is well past that: the application resolves Kotlin 2.4, and the oldest straggler on a tool classpath is kotlin-reflect 1.6.10 (detekt's). Dependency-Check matches the JetBrains Kotlin CPE against artifacts whose own version strings it cannot map to a Kotlin release — the stdlib-jdk7/jdk8 shims, kotlin-reflect, and the coroutines builds. The pattern spans the whole `org.jetbrains.*kotlin(x)` family on purpose, including IntelliJ's repackaged `org.jetbrains.intellij.deps.kotlinx` coroutines: a narrower prefix let those through, and the reasoning applies identically to all of them. Re-evaluate only if this project ever downgrades below Kotlin 1.4.21.

False positive — wrong artifact. CVE-2026-34481 affects `org.apache.logging.log4j:log4j-layout-template-json` (>= 2.14.0, < 2.25.4). That artifact is not on any classpath here; the only log4j artifacts present are log4j-api and log4j-to-slf4j (Spring Boot's SLF4J bridge), and both are at 2.25.4 or later. Dependency-Check matches on the shared `apache:log4j` CPE. Re-evaluate if log4j-layout-template-json is ever introduced.

False positive — wrong artifact within the same CVE. CVE-2026-49844 is a MapMessage JSON-serialization defect in `log4j-api` itself (2.13.1–2.25.4 and 2.26.0, fixed in 2.25.5 / 2.26.1). Dependency-Check additionally attributes it to `log4j-to-slf4j`, which merely bridges the Log4j API onto SLF4J and does not carry the affected code. NOTE: this suppression is deliberately scoped to log4j-to-slf4j ONLY, because it does not carry the defect at any version. log4j-api itself is constrained to `log4j-api.version` on every events-core configuration, testFixtures included, so the real finding is fixed rather than silenced here. Widening this entry to log4j-api would hide a regression in that constraint.

False positive — wrong product. CVE-2026-54285 is a missing size limit in `W3CBaggagePropagator.extract()` of `@opentelemetry/core`, the JavaScript client (opentelemetry-js < 2.8.0). The Java artifacts do not carry that code. Dependency-Check matches it on the shared OpenTelemetry CPE. Re-evaluate if the advisory ever names the Java artifacts or a Java version range.
